author: andrewgcodes
name: Combined Optimal: 10L seq2048 + val-only + sliding window + tuned Muon + int6
blurb: 10-layer transformer with seq_len=2048, val-only training (organizer-approved), sliding window eval (stride=64), tuned Muon optimizer (momentum=0.99, warmup from 0.92 over 1500 steps), int6 compression for layers 3-7, and lower learning rates. seq2048 outperforms seq4096 (1.0093 vs 1.0232 sw_eval).
